scope: Retrospective single-dataset end-of-first-semester dropout discrimination among resolved outcomes. Prior exploratory summaries on this snapshot are known.
shared_feature_engineering: approved/max(enrolled,1) and evaluations/max(enrolled,1) for all methods
outer: leave one course out, evaluating every resolved record once
inner: GroupKFold(3) by course; minimize mean course NLL; deterministic first minimum
candidate: additive cubic uniform-knot splines, 4 knots, L2 logistic regression
primary: mean per-course binary negative log likelihood
inference: paired course bootstrap, 10000 resamples, exact two-sided paired course sign-flip test under exchangeability, Holm across two comparisons
decision: Benchmark improvement only if both mean NLL gains reach 0.01, both bootstrap lower bounds exceed zero, and both Holm-adjusted p values are below .05. No tuning after evaluation.
